law_text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stop such vehicle upon any street at any place for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage other than at a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010], except in case of an emergency.
